Where was The White Lotus season 3 filmed? | Mainly on Koh Samui, at the Four Seasons Resort on the Laem Yai headland in the north-west, with further scenes at Anantara Bophut, Anantara Lawana's bar, Fisherman's Village, Choeng Mon Beach, Taling Ngam and a Maenam-area temple. Other scenes were shot in Bangkok, Phuket and at Haad Rin on Koh Phangan.
Which hotel is The White Lotus on Koh Samui? | The Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui at Laem Yai, about 5 km north of Nathon. Its villas, pool, beach and restaurants were used for the White Lotus resort. The hotel bar scenes were shot at the Singing Bird Lounge at Anantara Lawana, and some lobby scenes at Anantara Bophut.
How much does it cost to stay at the White Lotus hotel? | Published 2025–26 figures put standard rooms at about US$1,900 a night, two-bedroom villas at about US$8,500 and the largest villas at up to about US$14,000; a Thai report gave a range of about 43,000–320,000 THB a night. Rates are lower from May to October.
Can you visit the Four Seasons Koh Samui without staying there? | Not to look around: it is private, gated property. Luxury resorts on Samui sometimes take outside reservations for dinner or a spa, but we could not confirm the Four Seasons' current policy, so contact the resort before planning a visit. The best view for most people is from a boat offshore.
Can you see the White Lotus resort from a boat? | Yes. A private boat along the north-west coast passes the Laem Yai headland and the resort's bay, with a swim stop and a sunset off Lipa Noi or Nathon. Our private speedboats start from 19,000 THB per boat for up to 4 guests; catamarans and sunset cruises are slower alternatives.
Were scenes filmed elsewhere in Thailand? | Yes. Bangkok scenes used the Mandarin Oriental, Wat Pho pier and a private Thai villa; Phuket supplied the spa (Anantara Mai Khao), dinner restaurant (Rosewood), Muay Thai stadium and yacht scenes; and the Full Moon Party combined Choeng Mon Beach on Samui with Haad Rin on Koh Phangan.
Is Koh Samui really like the show? | Partly. The north-west coast, the luxury resorts and the temples look as they do on screen, but most of Samui is busier and more everyday: beach towns, markets, traffic and nightlife. You can enjoy the White Lotus side through a boat day, a sunset and a temple morning without the resort bill.
Is there a White Lotus filming locations tour on Koh Samui? | Yes. Our private van tour visits public locations such as Fisherman's Village and Choeng Mon and finishes on the west coast for sunset: 7,500 THB per van for up to 5 for 6 hours, or 9,500 THB with a licensed guide, with hotel pickup anywhere on Samui. By sea, a private boat passes the Four Seasons coast.
